en.content:
Given below are two statements :

Statement (I) : Neopentane forms only one monosubstituted derivative.

Statement (II) : Melting point of neopentane is higher than n-pentane.

In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below :

options.content: Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct
Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect
Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect

en.explanation:
Neopentane, , has four identical groups on one quaternary carbon, so all twelve hydrogens are equivalent and monohalogenation gives only one product, . Statement I is correct.

Melting point depends on how well the molecules pack in the crystal. The nearly spherical, highly symmetrical neopentane packs much better than the zig-zag n-pentane, so its melting point is far higher: neopentane , n-pentane . Statement II is correct.

Branching lowers the boiling point (neopentane , n-pentane ) because of the smaller surface area, but for melting point molecular symmetry decides.

Hence, the correct option is (B).

नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं :

कथन (I) : निओपेन्टेन मात्र एक एकल प्रतिस्थापित व्युत्पन्न निर्मित करता है।

कथन (II) : निओपेन्टेन का गलनांक -पेन्टेन की तुलना में उच्चतर होता है।

उपर्युक्त कथनों के आलोक में, नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही उत्तर चुनें :

कथन I और कथन II दोनों सही हैं
कथन I सही है, परन्तु कथन II गलत है
कथन I और कथन II दोनों गलत हैं

hi.explanation:
निओपेन्टेन, , में एक चतुर्थक कार्बन पर चार सर्वसम समूह हैं, अतः सभी बारह हाइड्रोजन तुल्य हैं और मोनोहैलोजनन से केवल एक उत्पाद बनता है। कथन I सही है।

गलनांक इस पर निर्भर करता है कि क्रिस्टल में अणु कितनी अच्छी तरह संकुलित होते हैं। लगभग गोलाकार, अत्यधिक सममित निओपेन्टेन, ज़िगज़ैग n-पेन्टेन की तुलना में कहीं बेहतर संकुलित होता है, अतः इसका गलनांक बहुत अधिक है : निओपेन्टेन , n-पेन्टेन । कथन II सही है।

शाखन से पृष्ठ क्षेत्रफल कम होने के कारण क्वथनांक घटता है (निओपेन्टेन , n-पेन्टेन ), परन्तु गलनांक के लिए अणु की सममिति निर्णायक होती है।

अतः, सही विकल्प (B) है।

Which of the following statements are true?

(A) The subsidiary quantum number describes the shape of the orbital occupied by the electron.

(B) is the boundary surface diagram of the orbital.

(C) The + and - signs in the wave function of the orbital refer to charge.

(D) The wave function of orbital is zero everywhere in the plane.

Choose the correct answer from the options given below :

options.content: (A) and (B) only
(B) and (D) only
(C) and (D) only
(A), (B) and (C) only

en.explanation:
(A) The subsidiary (azimuthal) quantum number defines the three-dimensional shape of the orbital: spherical (s), dumbbell (p), and so on. (A) is true.

(B) The boundary surface of consists of two lobes along the -axis on opposite sides of the nucleus, which is what the figure shows. (B) is true.

(C) The + and − signs on the lobes give the sign (phase) of the wave function, not electric charge. (C) is false.

(D) is proportional to , so it is zero only where , i.e. in the plane (the nodal plane). In the plane it is non-zero everywhere except along the -axis, so (D) is false.

Only (A) and (B) are true.

Hence, the correct option is (A).

Arrange the following in order of magnitude of work done by the system/on the system at constant temperature.

(a) for expansion in infinite stages.

(b) for expansion in single stage.

(c) for compression in infinite stages.

(d) for compression in single stage.

Choose the correct answer from the options given below :
en.explanation:
Consider an isothermal change of an ideal gas between state 1 and state 2 with and . The magnitude of work is the area under the – path.

Reversible path (infinite stages): at every step, so expansion and compression follow the same isotherm and

for both, so a = c.

Single-stage expansion: the gas expands against the final pressure , so , a rectangle lying under the isotherm. Hence b < a.

Single-stage compression: the gas is compressed by a constant external pressure equal to the final pressure , so , a rectangle enclosing the whole area under the isotherm. Hence d > c.

Therefore, d > c = a > b.

Hence, the correct option is (A).

en.content:
Reactant A converts to product D through the given mechanism (with the net evolution of heat):

A → B     slow;     ΔH = +ve

B → C     fast;     ΔH = -ve

C → D     fast;     ΔH = -ve

Which of the following represents the above reaction mechanism?
en.explanation:
The profile must show: A → B over the highest barrier (slow) with B above A (); C below B and D below C (both later steps exothermic) over small barriers (fast); and D below A, since heat is evolved overall.

Profile (A): C lies above B, so step B → C is endothermic, and D lies above A, so the overall reaction is endothermic.

Profile (B): D lies above A, so the overall reaction is endothermic; the step C → D also has a very large barrier, so it would not be fast.

Profile (C): C lies above B, so step B → C is endothermic.

Profile (D): A rises to B over the largest barrier, B → C and C → D each go downhill over small barriers, and D lies below A, so every condition is met.

Hence, the correct option is (D).

प्रोफ़ाइल (D) : A, सबसे बड़े अवरोध के ऊपर से B तक चढ़ता है, B → C और C → D प्रत्येक छोटे अवरोधों के ऊपर से नीचे की ओर जाते हैं, और D, A से नीचे है, इसलिए सभी प्रतिबंध पूरे होते हैं।

तापमान से तक:

पानी पर सबसे सघन होता है।

जैसे-जैसे तापमान से तक बढ़ता है, बढ़े हुए घनत्व के कारण पानी का आयतन कम हो जाता है।

आयतन में यह कमी मोलरता में वृद्धि का परिणाम देती है क्योंकि मोलरता विलयन के आयतन के व्युत्क्रमानुपाती होती है।

इसलिए, जैसे-जैसे तापमान तक बढ़ता है, पानी का आयतन बढ़ता है।

तनुकरण से मोलरता में कमी होती है, क्योंकि मोलरता आयतन के व्युत्क्रमानुपाती होती है।

en.explanation:
The correct matching is:

(A) Simple distillation → (III) Chloroform + Aniline

(B) Fractional distillation → (I) Diesel + Petrol

(C) Distillation under reduced pressure → (IV) Glycerol + Spent-lye

(D) Steam distillation → (II) Aniline + Water

So the answer is Option A.

Brief rationale:

Simple distillation (A):

•

• Δbp is large, so the lower-boiling chloroform distils off cleanly.

Fractional distillation (B):

• Petrol (40–200°C) and diesel (180–360°C) have overlapping but distinct boiling-range cuts.

• A fractionating column resolves them efficiently.

Vacuum distillation (C):

• Glycerol boils ≈290°C at 1 atm—too high for normal distillation.

• Lowering the pressure brings its boiling point down, letting you separate it from the spent-lye.

Steam distillation (D):

• Aniline (bp≈184°C) can be co-distilled with water around 98°C, avoiding thermal decomposition and separating it from the aqueous phase.
